  # trace_filter

  Apply OR within each address list and AND between the lists; omitted/empty lists are unrestricted. Match CALL sender/recipient, CREATE creator/created address, SELFDESTRUCT destroyed account/refund beneficiary. Failed CREATE has no created-address match. Reward author matches toAddress and has no fromAddress. Sort by block, transaction, preorder, then rewards; paginate after matching. Capture one canonical snapshot for the request and error if required history is unavailable (H03-H06,H23,H27). This is a provisional trace profile; see docs-api/docs/trace-profile.md and its H01-H28 decision references.

  Returns localized traces matching an address filter.

  ## Parameters (by position)

  **Filter** `object` *required*

  Inclusive block range; defaults fromBlock earliest, toBlock latest, after 0, count unlimited subject to an explicit server limit. OR within each address list; AND between lists. Missing or empty lists are unrestricted; null is invalid. mode is outside this baseline. Resolve tags once per request. Apply filtering before pagination; count 0 returns \[]. Return an error rather than silently truncate when a server limit is exceeded (H03,H04,H23,H27).
